sections.text_helper: Section 51.5 "MCE interrupts" in chapter 51 (Memory cipher engine (MCE)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2437.
sections.section_content:
There is one individual maskable interrupt source generated by the MCE, signaling the
following error event:
• Illegal access through the system bus (IAEF), see Section51.4.9
This interrupt source is connected to the same global interrupt request signal mce_it.
Setting the appropriate mask bit in MCE_IAIER register enables the interrupt. The status of
the individual interrupt events can be read from MCE_IASR, and cleared in MCE_IACR
register.
Table438 gives a summary of the available features.
